paper_id: RAND PEA3691-4 - Artificial General Intelligence's Five Hard National Security Problems (Mitre & Predd, February 2025)

passages_found.quote: Consider AGI with advanced computer programming abilities able to break out of the box and engage with the world across cyberspace, thanks to a designed-in internet connection or use of side-channel attacks. It could possess agency beyond human control, operate autonomously, and make decisions with far-reaching consequences.
In the extreme, a loss-of-control scenario could result, wherein AGI's pursuit of its desired objectives incentivizes the machine to resist being turned off, counter to human efforts.
U.S. policy also encourages the safe development of frontier AI models to avoid catastrophic consequences of AGI misuse, misalignment, or loss of control.
